title: Normalize inspector codes 1
scenario: An invented inspection register contains codes with ordinary spaces and nonprinting line breaks. Repeated codes represent separate records. All records and limits are fictitious training assumptions.

lesson.intro: Clean text before comparing it. CLEAN removes nonprinting characters, TRIM removes leading/trailing ordinary spaces and reduces repeated internal spaces, and UPPER standardizes letter case. Do not delete legitimate internal spaces.

formulas.name: CLEAN
formulas.explanation: text is a cell or string with nonprinting ASCII characters to remove.

formulas.name: TRIM
formulas.explanation: text is trimmed of ordinary edge spaces and repeated internal spaces.

formulas.name: UPPER
formulas.explanation: text letters become capitals; digits and punctuation remain.

task.prompt: For every row, remove nonprinting ASCII characters, trim ordinary spaces, collapse repeated internal spaces and uppercase letters. If the cleaned code is empty, return Missing. Preserve text 0 and legitimate single internal spaces. Keep dataset order and every duplicate record. Enter at B2 and fill down through B21; return text without rounding. Return 20 rows × 1 column, without a header, in Answers!B2:B21. Use an Excel formula; any equivalent approach is accepted. Submit the formula and the complete output.

columns.name: Inspector_text
columns.description: Raw code. Empty and space-only values are missing; text 0 is a valid code.
